A '''baked pumpkin''' is the simple preparation of the [[pumpkin]]. It heals {{Hp|2}} and grants {{EffectLink|Resistance}} for 30 seconds.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/baked_pumpkin.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
A pumpkin cooks into a baked pumpkin in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]] in 5 seconds. Picking up a pumpkin unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a baked pumpkin takes 1.6 seconds, heals {{Hp|2}} and gives Resistance I for 0:30.

Obtaining a baked pumpkin unlocks [[Pumpkin Jam|pumpkin jam]] and the [[Pumpkin Empanada|pumpkin empanada]]. It is also used in [[Pumpkin Curry Stock|pumpkin curry stock]].

=== Crafting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

== Advancements ==
* ''Powerful Flavors'': cook an intrinsic ingredient. Obtaining any of the 11 simple preparations of the ordinary intrinsic ingredients completes it.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/cook_food.json}}</ref>
